title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཟ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 101)
shelf_note: Canonical Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section (དབུ་མ, volume ཟ, vol. 101), containing Candrakīrti's Prasannapadā commentary on Nāgārjuna's Mūlamadhyamakakārikā chapter 24.

ocr_errors.problem: opening page head ornament (yig mgo) misread as the syllable na

tr_errors_B.english: then just as that fault is not fully known
tr_errors_B.problem: followed the OCR error reading skyon ('fault') instead of the woodblock's sdug bsngal ('suffering'), introducing an ungrounded comparison about a fault not being known

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly preserves the philosophical logic of the Four Noble Truths argument without being misled by the OCR error that corrupted 'suffering' (སྡུག་བསྔལ་) into 'fault' (སྐྱོན་).

book_verdict: Clear, authentic Derge Tengyur woodblock page preserving classical Madhyamaka commentary on the Four Noble Truths, accurately transcribed except for one minor header slip and one word misreading.
